notes.title: Patch 1.5.5
notes.content:
The 1.5.5 patch brings numerous Quality Of Life improvements and several bug fixes.  Thank you to the Poly Bridge 3 community for their endless support that helps make the game better!

Build Mode
[list]
* Added support for constraining node/foundation movement to X or Y axis.  Default bindings are N (Constrain to X Axis) and M (Constrain to Y Axis)
* Grid now draws in front of custom shapes and vehicles
* Fixed hydraulics not working after cut and double undo
* Fixed issue with clipboard changing in some undo cases
* Fixed issue with split joints not being reset when attached to prebuilds
* Fixed issue with custom shape outline width changing
[/list]
Trace Tool
[list]
* Added 'Snap Tangents' option (default=U)
* Change minimum length for Trace Fill to 0.5m (was 1m)
* Draw traceline over vehicles
* Highlight tangent handles on hover
* Always allow Fill if traceline is visible
* Allow changing trace shape and tangents lock/snap when traceline not present
[/list]
Sandbox
[list]
* Added support for re-ordering checkpoints
* Added support for converting an anchor to a node ("Convert To Node" button in anchor properties)
* Added skins for UFO vehicle
* Fixed issue with Quicksave (F6) for files in subdirectories
* Fixed UI overlap in Sandbox with Event Editor and Selection panel
[/list]
Workshop
[list]
* Added "Played by me" filter for Workshop Levels and Campaigns
* Added ability to Search when filtering by "Subscribed by me", "Favorited by me" and "Created by me"
* Added info icon for Workshop Item slots to provide author/date info on hover
* Number tutorials in Workshop Campaigns if there is more than one
* Fixed issue with number of levels sometimes being incorrect for Workshop Campaigns
[/list]
Gallery:
[list]
* Fixed issue with "Include Cheats" and "Wins Only" filters not always working correctly.
* Don't change gallery filters when gallery invoked from Help Icon
* Remove pre-patch replay from Curated Gallery
[/list]
UI
[list]
* Show Campaign Progress on Campaign UI
* Use YYYY-MM-DD date format for Japanese/Chinese/Korean languages
* Fixed issues with Replay popup
* Fixed artifact on rope/cable icons due to compression
[/list]
Mods
[list]
* Automatically download mods for Custom Shape Textures and Vehicle Skins when used by level
[/list]
Main Menu
[list]
* Added Main Menu shortcuts (R = load last sandbox level, C = load last campaign level)
* Fixed issue with zoom sometimes changing on Main Menu
[/list]
Simulation
[list]
* Added new split joint meshes (no longer using PB2-era split joint meshes)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.4
notes.content:
Patch 1.5.4 adds UI scaling and a new hotkey to visualize tooltips from hydraulics, springs and foundations.

[list]
* Added "UI Scale Mode" and "UI Scale Factor" to Graphics Options
* New hotkey (default=T) will show tooltips for all on-screen hydraulics, springs and foundations
* Trace tool UI/UX improvements
* Hydraulics and springs can be adjusted continuously by holding down the nudge keys ([ and ]).
* Shrink tooltip size if not running on Steam Deck
* Added mod hooks to get the UI Scale Mode and UI Scale Factor.
[/list]

Thank you for playing Poly Bridge 3!

notes.title: Patch 1.5.3
notes.content:
This update adds quality of life improvements and fixes a few bugs.  Thank you to the Poly Bridge 3 community for making suggestions and continuing to provide feedback that makes the game better!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Build Mode Improvements[/b]
[list]
* Clipboard no longer clears after undo/redo
* Added placement axes when placing or moving foundations
* Show hydraulic and spring tooltips when show-all-split joints button is held down
* Save 3-way split joint checkbox state (in bridge save)
* Clear traceline when trace tool is turned off
* Disable trace tool when move or erase tool is activated
[/list]
[b]Sandbox Improvements[/b]
[list]
* DPAD-style selection UI added for moving individual sandbox items
* Pan keyboard shortcuts now move selected sandbox items
* Set minimum movement increment to 0.001 (was 0.25)
[/list]
[b]UI Improvements[/b]
[list]
* Added Gallery button to the Campaign and Workshop Campaign UI
* Copy replay meta-data (e.g., level name, cost, author) to clipboard along with replay url
* Level Info banner now expands to accommodate longer text
* Added full gamepad controls to Workshop Campaign UI
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous Improvements[/b]
[list]
* Allow NumPad Enter to be used in all places Return gets used
* Help hotkey (F1) now brings up Gallery in Workshop Levels
* Set filters for Gallery when opening for help purposes (Wins only, No cheats)
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
* Fixed default zoom level for Roll Top Avenue and Faulty Drive
* Fixed hydraulic trusses overlapping other materials (visual bug only)
* Fixed issue with Gallery thumbnail sometimes being from a different video (rare)
* Fixed "ghost" material bug (rare)
* Fixed race condition that could result in replay uploading with wrong level ID (rare)
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
Try out the new and exciting world, "Roll Top Avenue", a four-sheep difficulty world where things can get a little bit wacky.  You will really need some out of the box thinking to beat this world!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Physics[/b]
[list]
* Friction of bridge nodes refactored so they don't 'stick' to terrain edges
* Fixed issue that allowed many short parts connected together to stretch significantly
* Fixed rare issue where vehicles can be jolted unexpectedly when a wheel aligns perfectly with the edge of a road or platform
* Set Cheat Flag when a car are thrown by falling roads
* Set Cheat Flag when a massive forces break wheels off a car
* Updated behavior of 3-way split joints in rare cases
* Exclude prebuilt materials in non-buildable areas from contributing to max stress calculation
[/list]
[b]Material Masses Updated[/b]
[list]
* Base Node Mass: 0 => 0.0625 Pg
* Road: 0.75 => 0.5 Pg/m
* Wood: 0.05 => 0.1 Pg/m
* Steel: 0.1 => 0.175 Pg/m
* Hydraulic: 0.125 => 0.225 Pg/m
* Rope: 0.025 => 0.075 Pg/m
* Cable: 0.025 => 0.075 Pg/m
* Spring: 0.05 => 0.1 Pg/m
[/list]
[b]Leaderboard Reset[/b]
[list]
* Top 2.5% of scores for each level in the Overall and Unbreaking leaderboards are being reset.

We do everything we can to avoid resetting leaderboard scores. From our internal analysis getting scores in the top 2.5% often required abuse of  physics exploits that are being patched.  To encourage fair competition scores that are no longer possible after the physics update had to be removed.
[/list]
[b]Workshop[/b]
[list]
* Add support for setting unlimited budget and materials for solved weeklies and workshop levels
* Show progress icons for workshop levels
* Show level author name for workshop levels in the Level Info UI
* Don't allow invalid Campaign Mods to be uploaded
* Fixed flip for UGC vehicles
[/list]
[b]Weekly Challenges[/b]
[list]
* Fixed Season 2 weekly challenge progress icons in level dropdown
* Fixed issues related to reloading workshop levels with mod dependencies
[/list]
[b]Level Updates[/b]
[list]
* Minor tweaks where an anchor or prebuild was moved a small fraction to align with grid
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
* Base cost of Foundations reduced from $15,000 to $13,000
* Allow game window to be resized when not running in fullscreen mode
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Workshop Campaigns are now available!

Be on the lookout for user created Campaigns in the new "Campaigns" section on the Workshop. There is already a Master Mode Workshop Campaign (created by community members)!  Master Mode will challenge you with harder versions of every level from the Campaign!

It is easy to create your own Workshop Campaign too, just visit the "Created Mods" tab and click on "Create New Campaign Mod". This will create a template mod for setting up your own campaign. You can use levels from other creators in your campaign if you like (the original author is shown on the Workshop Campaign UI).
